metadata.title: Family & Parenting Resources — Murray Partners 4 Prevention
metadata.description: A curated directory of free and low-cost family, parenting, and youth resources for Murray, Utah families — gathered by Murray Partners 4 Prevention.

hero.headline: Family & Parenting Resources
hero.subheadline: Free and low-cost tools, classes, and support for Murray families — supporting residents, connecting families, empowering youth, and fostering lifelong growth.

sections.body: Murray Partners 4 Prevention highlights the Coalition's work in the community by supporting residents, connecting families, empowering youth, and fostering lifelong growth. Below are trusted local and statewide resources to help every family thrive. Tap any card to learn more.

items.title: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
items.description: Call or text 988 to talk with a caring counselor about mental health struggles, emotional distress, alcohol or drug use concerns, or when you just need to talk. You are not alone.

items.title: Parent Guidance
items.description: Free, on-demand courses on parenting topics including anxiety, behavior, addiction, body image, and technology, plus an “Ask a Therapist” section. Murray City School District families can also access FREE one-on-one parent coaching.

items.title: Salt Lake County Youth Services
items.description: Free services for guardians — including Guiding Good Choices and Staying Connected with Your Teen — plus classes for teens such as Me Time, Stress Busters, and the Body Project. Offered in English and Spanish.

items.title: USU Extension: Parenting & Youth Classes
items.description: Healthy Relationships Utah hosts free online courses including Couple LINKS, Home Run Parents, Parenting the Love and Logic Way, Positive Discipline, Smart Dating, and Smart Steps for Stepfamilies.

items.title: The Social Institute
items.description: Resources to help parents navigate the world of tech with their children, including free online courses and a Family Toolkit with step-by-step guides for nearly every app. Email Sierra Marsh for the access code, or find it in Murray City School District's ParentSquare communications.

items.title: Parents Empowered
items.description: A statewide media and community education campaign giving parents concrete tools and strategies to keep kids' brains alcohol-free. Visit the No Bummer Summer campaign for a summer parenting quiz, bucket-list generator, and more.

items.title: CHAT Campaign
items.description: An initiative from the Utah Department of Health and Human Services offering tools for meaningful family connection, including the free Family Connection for Healthy Futures toolkit. Resources offered in English and Spanish.

items.title: Family Support Center
items.description: Located in nearby Taylorsville, the Family Support Center offers free and low-cost parenting classes and groups, free short-term childcare for children ages 0–11, and more.

items.title: Project Personality / Project YES
items.description: Free, online, anonymous courses designed to instill hope and self-efficacy in teens ages 11–17 by teaching a growth mindset — improving mood, reframing negative thoughts, and more. Available in English and Spanish.

items.title: Murray Children's Pantry
items.description: Receive food support or donate to this local food pantry working to eliminate childhood hunger in Murray. Located at 170 East 5770 South. Open Tuesdays 10am–Noon and the third Saturday of each month 10am–Noon, or by appointment.

items.title: Murray City School District: Family Resources
items.description: A variety of parent and community resources from the Murray City School District Family and Community Resources Page. Note: you can change the page to display in any language.

sections.heading: Get Involved with the Coalition
sections.body: Murray Partners 4 Prevention is a Communities That Care coalition building a connected, compassionate Murray where all residents are empowered to thrive, grow, and build a stronger, safer community together.
